description: Compute a company's OSHA injury and illness incidence rates from its Form 300A totals and hours worked, for safety reporting and contractor prequalification. Send one entry per year (up to 5): total hours worked by all employees and the case counts from Form 300A columns G (deaths), H (days away from work), I (job transfer or restriction) and J (other recordable cases). Get back per year and for all years pooled: the total recordable incident rate (TRIR, nonfatal cases H + I + J, as BLS computes it, and also with deaths added), the DART rate (H + I), the days-away rate (H), all per 200,000 hours, plus the plain average of the yearly rates and, if you send them, how each compares with a benchmark rate you supply. Counts only: no names or case details. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/osha-incident-rates). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

benchmark_dart.description: Optional: a DART rate to compare against.

benchmark_trir.description: Optional: a TRIR to compare against (an industry rate you looked up, or a contract's maximum).

label.description: Optional label, e.g. 'prequal 2027' (your own text, echoed; no names of workers).

years.description: One entry per calendar year (up to 5).

days_away_cases.description: Cases with days away from work (OSHA Form 300A column H). Default 0.

deaths.description: Cases resulting in death (OSHA Form 300A column G). Default 0.

hours_worked.description: Total hours actually worked by all employees that year (Form 300A; no vacation, sick or other paid leave).

other_cases.description: Other recordable cases (OSHA Form 300A column J). Default 0.

restricted_cases.description: Cases with job transfer or restriction (OSHA Form 300A column I). Default 0.

name: osha_incident_rates
title: OSHA Incident Rates (TRIR, DART)
